comment: scrolled content at the clip edges of overflow: hidden (the one-pixel line above the top edge that p3-grid found is the drivers' MSAA scissor, see below). The boxes are scrolled so that a transparent gap, then a coloured stripe, crosses the top edge of the padding box. Rendered without MSAA ("samples": 1), at the default tolerances: with 4x MSAA, Mesa's llvmpipe and lavapipe (the test image's GL and Vulkan drivers, Mesa 23.2.1) let half the samples of the row above and the column left of a scissor rectangle through, so content scrolled past a clip edge would show a half-covered 1 px line there (MsaaScissor.FourSamples reproduces it with raw sokol calls; the scissor reaches glScissor/vkCmdSetScissor as exact integers, the max edges are exact)
